subsystems.name: tower_L
subsystems.note: west tower, tall arched belfry openings

content.text: Base plinth, then the west facade block with three portals and the rose opening.
Filling the rose with mixed trans bricks, then raising both towers with tall arched belfry openings.
Nave walls now — 13 courses with a glowing clerestory band.
Aisles with stained-glass windows and a dark lean-to roof.
Flying buttresses: eight piers with pinnacles and flyer arches springing to the nave wall.
Black stepped nave roof and the crossing spire.
Adding strut bricks under each flyer arch to tie the buttress piers into the church.
Re-laying the ground base directly at y=0 with anchored plates so every wall sits on it again.
The base layer is unrecoverable in place — rebuilding cleanly, with the base plates only under the walls so everything bonds into one structure.
